Type.name: Demo.ViewModels.ControllerViewModel
Type.Text: 派生的Node组件之一，作为任务发起者
A derived Node component that acts as a workflow initiator/controller. Default size: 230×170. Never use Size(0,0).

Member.name: Compile
Member.Text: 编译：以自身为起点，把可达子图分解成编译图，并给各节点注入编译身份
Compile: decompose the reachable subgraph from this controller into compiled graphs.

Member.name: Run
Member.Text: 运行：用编译图 + 执行引擎驱动整条链
Run: drive the compiled graph with the execution engine.

Member.name: Resume
Member.Text: 继续：从上次运行的检查点接着跑（已完成的节点不再驱动，产物照旧交给下游）
Resume: carry on from the previous run's checkpoint — done nodes are not driven again, their outputs are restored.

Member.name: Stop
Member.Text: 停止：取消当前运行
Stop: cancel the current run.

Member.name: CloseWorkflow
Member.Text: 关闭工作流，释放所有正在运行的任务
Closes the workflow and releases all in-progress work items.

Member.name: OutputSlot
Member.Text: 输出口
Output slot (sender). Connect this to the first downstream node's input slot to start the execution chain.

Member.name: isActive
Member.Text: 是否处于活跃状态
Indicates whether the workflow is currently running.

Member.name: seedPayload
Member.Text: 种子负载，工作流执行时的初始数据
Initial payload string injected into the workflow context when execution starts.

Type.name: Demo.ViewModels.EnumSelectorNodeViewModel
Type.Text: 枚举选择器节点，可将输入按枚举成员路由到多个执行路径。默认大小为 280×380。
Enum selector node that routes input to multiple execution paths based on enum members. Default size: 280×380.

Member.name: InputSlot
Member.Text: 输入口（接收端）
Input slot (receiver)

Member.name: OutputSlots
Member.Text: 输出口（发送端）
Output slot (sender). Supports the demo's VoltageRange routing enum.

Member.name: title
Member.Text: 标题

Member.name: autoBroadcast
Member.Text: 是否自动广播给下游节点
When true, the node automatically forwards the result to all connected downstream nodes after execution.

Member.name: SelectedValue
Member.Text: 当前选中的枚举值，决定路由到哪个输出口
Currently selected enum value. Determines which output slot receives the routed input. Set to the desired enum member name (string) or its underlying integer value.

Member.name: _compileMode
Member.Text: 编译模式：Static 编译期锁定当前选中分支（未选中分支被剪除，其下游节点 Order = -1 绝对停止）；Dynamic 运行期按数据负载重新选分支（全部分支存活，编译期 payload 为 null 时 ResolveRouteKey 返回 null）。通过 PatchNodeProperties 设置，如 {"CompileMode":"Static"}。

Compile mode: Static locks the currently selected branch at compile time (unselected branches are pruned; their downstream nodes get Order = -1 / absolute stop); Dynamic re-selects the branch at runtime from the data payload (all branches stay alive; ResolveRouteKey returns null for a null compile-time payload). Set via PatchNodeProperties, e.g. {"CompileMode":"Static"}.

Type.name: Demo.ViewModels.DatasetSource
Type.Text: Dataset source: Synthetic generates samples in-process, SampleFile reads a recorded set.

Member.name: usePolyline
Member.Text: True表示使用折线连接两个节点

Type.name: Demo.ViewModels.PythonPortProvider
Type.Text: Python 节点的动态端口提供器（实现 ISlotProvider）。先用 GetTypeSchema('Demo.ViewModels.PythonPortProvider') 查看属性结构，再构造 JSON 传给 SetEnumSlotCollection 重建输入/输出口。

Python node dynamic port provider (implements ISlotProvider). Call GetTypeSchema('Demo.ViewModels.PythonPortProvider') first to inspect the property structure, then construct the JSON and pass it to SetEnumSlotCollection to rebuild the input/output ports.

Type.name: Demo.ViewModels.PythonPort
Type.Text: 单个动态端口定义，当前仅包含名称 Name。
One dynamic port definition; currently only carries the port Name.

Member.name: Name
Member.Text: 端口名称（也是路由键，以及脚本 input.json 中该上游产物对应的字段名）
Port name (also the routing key, and the field name under which this upstream's output arrives in the script's input.json).

Type.name: Demo.ViewModels.PythonScriptNodeViewModel
Type.Text: Python 脚本节点：把上游数据（单值或汇合字典）写成 input.json，用 CliWrap 执行 Script 里的 Python 代码，读回 output.json 作为结果传给下游。输入/输出口由 PythonPortProvider 动态生成。默认大小 280×240

Python script node: writes the upstream payload (single value or joined dictionary) to input.json, executes the Python code in Script via CliWrap, and feeds the parsed output.json result downstream. Input/output ports are dynamically generated by PythonPortProvider. Default size: 280×240

Member.name: InputSlots
Member.Text: 输入口（动态，由 PythonPortProvider 生成）。用 SetEnumSlotCollection 重建：selectorTypeOrJson=PythonPortProvider 的 JSON，nonEnumTypeName='Demo.ViewModels.PythonPortProvider'

Input slots (dynamic, generated by PythonPortProvider). Rebuild via SetEnumSlotCollection: pass the provider's JSON to 'selectorTypeOrJson' and 'Demo.ViewModels.PythonPortProvider' to 'nonEnumTypeName'.

Member.name: OutputSlots
Member.Text: 输出口（动态，由 PythonPortProvider 生成）。用 SetEnumSlotCollection 重建，方式同输入口
Output slots (dynamic, generated by PythonPortProvider). Rebuild via SetEnumSlotCollection, same as the input slots.

Member.name: script
Member.Text: Python 源码文本。执行契约：python <script.py> <input.json> <output.json>。脚本读 input.json：线性输入为上游产物原样；汇合输入为 {端口名: 上游产物} 字典。脚本把结果 JSON 写入 output.json（或直接打印到 stdout）。示例：import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1],encoding='utf-8')); json.dump({'pass':1}, open(sys.argv[2],'w',encoding='utf-8'))。

Python source text. Execution contract: python <script.py> <input.json> <output.json>. The script reads input.json: on a linear chain the upstream output is passed as-is; at a join it is a {portName: upstreamOutput} dictionary. The script writes its result JSON to output.json (or prints it to stdout). Example: import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1],encoding='utf-8')); json.dump({'pass':1}, open(sys.argv[2],'w',encoding='utf-8')).

Member.name: title
Member.Text: 标题
Display title shown in the node header.

Member.name: pythonExecutable
Member.Text: Python 可执行文件（默认 python，也可填完整路径）
Python executable (default 'python'; may be a full path).

Member.name: description
Member.Text: 节点作用描述：说明这个 Python 节点做什么（输入/输出、计算逻辑、用途），供 Agent 理解并在画布上展示。可用 PatchNodeProperties 修改。
Description of what this Python node does (inputs/outputs, computation, purpose) — helps the Agent and is shown on the canvas. Editable via PatchNodeProperties.

Type.name: Demo.ViewModels.SlotViewModel
Type.Text: A derived Slot component. Used as the sender (output) or receiver (input) endpoint of a connection.

Type.name: Demo.ViewModels.TimerNodeViewModel
Type.Text: 定时器节点：作为数据源，每次执行产出当前时间戳，并通过单一路由键 tick 扇出到所有下游（供并行计算与汇合演示）。默认大小 200×140

Timer node: acts as a data source that emits the current timestamp each run and fans out to all downstream targets via the single route key 'tick' (for parallel computation and join demos). Default size: 200×140

Member.name: InputSlot
Member.Text: 输入口（接收端），接上游触发节点
Input slot (receiver). Connect an upstream trigger here.

Member.name: OutputSlot
Member.Text: 输出口（发送端），图上设为 MultipleTargets 以扇出到多个下游
Output slot (sender). Set it to MultipleTargets on the graph to fan out to several downstream nodes.

Member.name: title
Member.Text: 标题
Display title shown in the node header.

Member.name: intervalMilliseconds
Member.Text: 定时器间隔（毫秒），仅作展示，不影响执行
Timer interval in milliseconds (display only; does not affect execution).

Member.name: lastTick
Member.Text: 最近一次 tick 的时间戳
Timestamp of the most recent tick.

Type.name: Demo.ViewModels.TreeViewModel
Type.Text: The workflow tree (canvas). Contains all nodes, slots, and connections. This is the root scope the Agent operates on.
